say:2:1830187001:1.text: Ah, that's because I only get the jitters before going onstage. The moment I step out there, they disappear!
say:2:1830187001:1.source_cn: 啊哈，我是上台前紧张，站到舞台上就不紧张了。

say:3:1830187002:1.text: Once I get into character and immerse myself in the scene, I stop feeling nervous altogether.
say:3:1830187002:1.source_cn: 脑袋里幻想着我就是这个角色，让自己成为角色本人，走进情...

say:4:1830187003:1.text: Wait... I remember you! You played Rande, didn't you? You actually did better than some of us with centuries of acting experience!
say:4:1830187003:1.source_cn: 你……我记得你，你是兰利的演员！你的表现比我们这里好多...
say:4:1830187003:1.male: Wait... I remember you! You played Rande, didn't you? You actually did better than some of us with centuries of acting experience!
say:4:1830187003:1.female: Wait... I remember you! You played Rande, didn't you? You actually did better than some of us with centuries of acting experience!

say:5:1830187004:1.text: Exactly! You absolutely nailed that final scene!
say:5:1830187004:1.source_cn: 我也记得你，最后一幕的演出实在太完美了！
say:5:1830187004:1.male: Exactly! You absolutely nailed that final scene!
say:5:1830187004:1.female: Exactly! You absolutely nailed that final scene!

say:6:1830187005:1.text: Tell you what, you've got both the looks and the talent for acting. I swear, you'd have looked even better if I'd done your makeup that night!
say:6:1830187005:1.source_cn: 而且你长得也不错，完全是个当演员的料。真是的，应该让我...
